providerCleanup.crashBackstop: MANUAL recovery uses existing provider list/remove after matching this durable intent and unique run tags; no broad pool/ephemeral sweep that touches other sessions, no TTL/automatic lease claim
providerCleanup.terminal: Any uncertain creation, unsettled job or unverified deletion prevents a passing fixture status
